defect: Explicitly selected plan or policy FIFO blocks the read-only release verification CLI waiting for a writer; the same unbounded input read also accepts arbitrarily large regular control files.
method: Execute the actual Python CLI in subprocesses against private temporary assets. Reuse assets and build_documents fixtures, including real version_plan.create_plan/sync_versions and a real receipt. os.mkfifo creates an explicit control path with no writer. Bound each before/after process to one second. Both revisions receive the same valid external-file positive control and the same FIFO as --plan or --policy. The original source was loaded from 8b22794; the original after experiment used local 3aa9e43, whose script and test bytes match public eea722d and the reviewed source.
command_shape: <python> <revision-specific release_signatures.py> verify-build <private assets> --plan <private plan or FIFO> --policy <private policy or FIFO>
scope: A local CLI robustness defect, not an HTTP path traversal. Explicit trusted files outside the checkout and symlink aliases to regular files remain accepted. This does not test elevated privileges, a running service, or production release publication.

counting: The plan/policy FIFO and size/type checks concern one control-input issue in a newly introduced feature. No historical defect or regression credit is assigned; discovery after an intermediate review does not create an exception to the new-feature exclusion.
classification: Validation of a new Silver feature; excluded from both the historical defect denominator and regression numerator.
